## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle commentary on the *[Smaller Sukhāvatī](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0082)* is by the Silla master [元曉](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E6%9B%89) Wǒnhyo. Distinct from *[Wǒnhyo's Two-Fascicle Larger Sukhāvatī Zōng yào](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0067)* (T1747); the present commentary treats the *Smaller* parallel.
